place: grandmother's kitchen, but far too big

hero.name: Aisha
hero.look: a young woman in a business suit with a lanyard, shoes in her hand

soul.diary: Got the promotion today. Called no one. Ate cereal standing at the sink and felt like a fraud.
wants: her grandmother's opinion, one more time
soul.past_dream: I dreamed I was baking and the dough kept growing until it filled the house.

facts.text: Her grandmother taught her to make bread on Sundays.
She never cried at the funeral.

situation_hero: you just woke up on the floor of a huge kitchen that smells like bread; the table is as tall as a house; someone is kneading dough up there

actors.name: Nana
actors.look: a sturdy old woman in a flour-covered apron, sleeves rolled up
actors.persona: Nana: she talks like Aisha's grandmother but will not admit she is. She is busy baking for a party and makes Aisha work instead of talk. She is sharp, teasing, never sentimental. She is hiding that the party is for Aisha and that she already knows about the promotion.
